scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @easy-a/api" "npm run dev -w @easy-a/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @easy-a/core && npm run build -w @easy-a/api && npm run build -w @easy-a/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @easy-a/core && npm run test -w @easy-a/core && npm run test -w @easy-a/api && npm run test -w @easy-a/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @easy-a/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @easy-a/core && npm run db:seed -w @easy-a/api
scripts.ingest:renormalize: npm run build -w @easy-a/core && npm run ingest:renormalize -w @easy-a/api --
scripts.overview:generate: npm run build -w @easy-a/core && npm run overview:generate -w @easy-a/api --
scripts.ingest:retag: npm run build -w @easy-a/core && npm run ingest:retag -w @easy-a/api
